name: lz4-java v1.11.4
body:
**Security release for [CVE-2026-106450](https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/security/advisories/GHSA-gm45-99xc-r7wv), [CVE-2026-106449](https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/security/advisories/GHSA-343h-94h5-c4wr) and [CVE-2026-106451](https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/security/advisories/GHSA-mcr4-qmvw-px4g).** Also includes general fixes for bugs found by AI.

## What's Changed
* Update astral-sh/setup-uv action to v10.2.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/97
* Update dependency com.carrotsearch.randomizedtesting:randomizedtesting-runner to v2.9.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/98
* Update cloudflare/wrangler-action digest to 953926a by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/99
* Fix NPE in LZ4FrameInputStream on skippable-only streams by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/125
* Release source critical array before throwing OOM in LZ4JNI by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/124
* Fix stale OutOfMemoryError reference in XXHashJNI by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/127
* Reject truncated block header in LZ4BlockInputStream by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/128
* Don't restore the Maven cache in the release workflow by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/132
* Read skippable frame size as unsigned in LZ4FrameInputStream by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/131
* Only run test workflow on push to main by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/136
* Document CPU cost of high HC compression levels by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/141
* Fix int overflow in streaming XXHash update buffering check by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/138
* docs: declare requires-python >= 3.12 in justfile scripts by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/130
* Make docs manual-dispatch deploy branch explicit by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/137
* Switch Maven wrapper to script-only and use strict checksums in CI by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/144
* Verify SHA-256 of lz4 CLI downloaded in Windows release job by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/134
* docs: validate version input and tag names before interpolating them by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/142
* Test safe decompressors with destination offsets and buffer kinds by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/146
* Document that StreamingXXHash32.asChecksum() returns only 28 bits by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/140
* Declare explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions in workflows by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/135
* Only publish to Central from v* tags by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/139
* Test the darwin/aarch64 native library before publishing by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/143
* Fix negative LZ4BlockInputStream.available() after an empty block by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/129
* Delete .clinerules by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/148
* Rework README, add contributing guide, Scorecard and coverage by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/147
* Fix test compilation on main: remove duplicate testAvailableAfterEmptyBlock by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/149


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/compare/v1.11.3...v1.11.4
